question: Who is eligible to participate in BIC InnovateX 2026?
answer: Undergraduate and graduate students from any recognized college or university, as well as recent graduates (within 1 year of graduation). Cross-institutional and cross-disciplinary squads are welcomed.

question: What is the team size requirement?
answer: Teams must consist of 2 to 4 members. If you do not have a team yet, you can register as an individual, and our team-matching mixer will pair you with complimentary builders.

question: Is participation free of cost?
answer: Yes, 100% free! Accepted participants receive complimentary high-speed Gigabit Wi-Fi, 48-hour continuous catering, high-protein midnight refreshments, and exclusive swag boxes.

question: Can we bring pre-existing projects or codebases?
answer: No. All project repositories must be created fresh at the start of Day 1 hacking. Using existing open-source libraries, frameworks, APIs, and public cloud packages is encouraged, but your core application logic must be built during the hackathon.

question: Who retains intellectual property (IP) rights to our builds?
answer: You own 100% of your code and intellectual property. Neither BIC nor sponsors claim any equity, licensing, or IP ownership over participant submissions.
